testcase.name: offline subscriber - the write succeeds and delivery lands durably in the inbox()
cross-node fan-out - events reach a subscriber homed on the other node()
single agent - the game agent runs only on the owner node()
graceful drain - a stopped node's rooms re-claim with no TTL wait()
unreachable peer gateway - fan-out failure neither fails the write nor blocks other sessions()
fencing - a node partitioned from the claim store demotes and never resurrects()
failover - a crashed owner's rooms are stolen after TTL expiry()
write forwarding - non-owner forwards to the owner and relays its response()
